purpose: Durable failure-before-fix regression evidence for the BusyStack CalDAV correction pass. This file is not green qualification or a final artifact report.
evidenceBoundary: The paths under /tmp identify retained local raw logs. Their hashes, exact outcomes, and selected failure text are recorded here; availability of those local raw files is not implied for a fresh checkout.
No failed, interrupted, inferred, or unexecuted run is represented as a pass. Counts refer to complete Maven test summaries, not assertion counts.
Exact shell invocations are included only where retained. Observed goals and test names do not establish all original CLI/environment options.
The original namespace regression attempt that hit a same-calendar UID collision is excluded. Only the corrected baseline2 execution supports that finding.

isolatedReviewedSource.testSource: New regression methods copied into the isolated archive; tests are intentionally additional to the reviewed commit. Production sources and resources remain unchanged.

interpretation: Nine new regressions all fail against the unchanged reviewed production source: five assertion failures and four expected-behavior errors.
Both initial synchronization tests fail with StoreException LIMIT. The capacity fixture contains 10,037 resources and asserts its stored content exceeds 32 MiB before requesting pages of 137.
Group grant listing and membership maintenance fail with StoreException LIMIT after accepting the large states.
Namespace admission and transfer preflight unexpectedly accept inaccessible destination states.
Inherited xml:lang is empty instead of fr; repeated individually valid property updates encounter no aggregate rejection; mixed-success calendar-multiget returns whole-request 404 rather than 207.
